intraday/overnight volatility share replaces C low-vol leg

known_limitations: Common window starts 2022-05-05 because TTM C-sleeve data starts then.
Industry classification uses a current snapshot backfilled through history.
ETF qfq caches are not official PIT total-return series.
5x net-contribution concentration remains fragile when net profit is thin.

latest_independent_factor.finding: independent risk composition but no C-sleeve return increment

next_research_guidance: Do not repeat single risk-factor substitutions in the same C sleeve without a new return source or a different portfolio role.
Institutional research-visit data is only available for roughly one recent year and individual fund-flow history is only 120 sessions; do not fabricate long history.
Further work should test a genuinely independent return source, or a portfolio-structure change that directly broadens 5x net-profit generation.
